content.text:
I added `UserRepository.findByEmail(email)` and a test for it. `npm test` passes all 11 tests.

- **Method** (`src/repositories/user-repository.js:20`): it follows the existing promise style and returns the matching user, or `null` if there isn't one. It skips soft-deleted users, the same as the existing callback version in `src/services/auth-service.js`, so that service can switch to the repository without changing what it returns. This differs from the repository's own `findById`, which does return soft-deleted users.
- **Test** (`tests/repositories.test.js:11`): checks three cases: an active user is found, an unknown email returns `null`, and a soft-deleted user (`alan@example.com`) returns `null`.

I didn't change any service code and didn't add any dependencies.
